lines.text: Sarah bore Abraham a son at the promised time, and Abraham circumcised Isaac when he was eight days old.
Abraham was seventy-five years old when Isaac was born, and he circumcised the boy at eight days.
Abraham held a great feast when Isaac was weaned, and Sarah told him to expel Hagar and her son.
Abraham gave Hagar bread and a skin of water, and she wandered in the Wilderness of Sinai.
God opened Hagar's eyes to a well, and Ishmael grew up as an archer in the Wilderness of Paran.
